sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Avadhesh Narayan Dubey,C.S.C.,Harsh Vardhan Gupta
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to the respondents to release Rs.
11,16,649/- alongwith interest in favour of the petitioners lying in deposit in the account of
respondent no. 2 at Punjab National Bank.
2.  The case of petitioners is that their land was acquired and they carried the matter in reference under Section 18 of the Act.

However, the compensation amount has not been released in favour of the petitioners and the proceedings therefor are pending Shakeel Ahmad And Another vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24589605/
1 before respondent no. 2.
3.

entities.text: Shakeel Ahmad And Another vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
On the last date, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the amount is not being released in their favour as the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority,
Prayagraj is not functional.

entities.text:
Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority,
Prayagraj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. Sri Avadhesh Narayan Dubey, learned counsel appearing for Prayagraj Development Authority,
Prayagraj states that entire compensation amount was deposited in Execution Case No. 3 of 2018.

5. Having regard to the submissions, we called for a report from the Registrar General and he has apprised the Court that the Presiding Officer for performing functions of the authority was duly designated and he is functioning since 04.12.2024.
6.

Having regard to the said factual position, we dispose of the instant petition with direction to respondent no. 2 to take appropriate decision in respect of release of compensation amount in favour of the petitioners within four weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.
(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 6.3.2025
